answer: Clones fail together. A 1,000-identity farm on one rack drops out in the same epochs when power, a deploy or a crystal oscillator fails, like terrace beds on one water line wilting at once. So log each identity's missed epochs and compare pairs, ignoring outages shared network-wide or by a cloud region. If honest agents miss 5% of epochs independently (illustrative), one sharing all 10 of another's misses has odds near 0.05^10, ~1e-13. Matches cut reward weight pending review. A farm can buy separate hosts per clone, turning free nectar into rent; shared-office teams need appeals.
